auction.time: First Tuesday of each month, 10:00 am to 4:00 pm (next business day if the first Tuesday is a legal holiday); bidder sign-in 8:30 am to 9:45 am
auction.registration: Online pre-registration is required through the Sheriff's bidder registration form (gtsweb.com/fultoncounty); it opens when the sale list is published and closes at 2:00 pm the Monday before the sale. No registration is allowed on sale day. Confirm your registration at sign-in before 9:45 am with the driver's license or government ID used to register.
auction.payment: Cashier's check payable to the Fulton County Sheriff's Office; no money orders. The bid must be paid in full on the day of the sale and the purchaser completes a Purchaser Data Sheet.
auction.office: Fulton County Sheriff's Office, Property Tax (Tax Sales)
auction.office_address: 185 Shirley C. Franklin Blvd. SW, Atlanta, GA 30303
vital: Sales are run by the Sheriff, not the Tax Commissioner, and you cannot register on sale day.
A Sheriff's Tax Deed conveys only defeasible title; to get fee simple title the buyer must foreclose or bar the right to redeem, or let title ripen by prescription, under state law.
The tax deed and transfer tax form are recorded within 30 days of the sale; the Levy Officer may rescind any sale within 30 days with a full refund.
A bidder who fails to pay is liable for the purchase money and the property can be resold (O.C.G.A. 9-13-170).
A courtesy list runs in the Wednesday Neighbor newspapers for four weeks before the sale and the current list is posted on the Sheriff's tax sales page.
Excess funds above taxes and costs are noticed to interested parties and claimed by written application to the Sheriff's Office.
